items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: The name 'John' appears in the interviewer's turn ('Yeah, Duff Ernest, John.' and 'there was Wendell and there was a John too I think back there') and in the song title 'Who Struck John?'. The interviewee does not mention a personal relationship with a specific person named John, only responding to

ctx.x: From front, from front of town. Yeah. His brother played in the band.
